visual_review.text: Visually matches original Russian title and complete two-line rule, including 3 victory points.
visual_review.coins: Six gold coins in original left column.
visual_review.medallion: Purple/pink special-district medallion retained; small ornament details are regenerated.
visual_review.composition: Diagonal bridge, two stone dragon heads, glowing gateway, angle and parchment layout remain closely aligned.
visual_review.limitations: Strongly clearer and more saturated than original. Dark stone, bridge supports, spikes, tiny bridge silhouettes and flames contain newly interpreted details; faithful overall composition does not guarantee exact microgeometry or object-by-object fidelity. Blue shadows and fire contrast are stronger.
